name: repo-ai
description: The ai-loop pipeline split out of @rtorcato/repo-tooling: skills that take an ai-ready GitHub issue to a reviewed PR.

plugins.name: repo-ai
plugins.description: Three skills: ai-loop (the entry point and engine), ai-issue (the on-ramp) and ai-loop-status (a read-only view). They call the @rtorcato/repo-ai CLI via npx. Unversioned: tracks main.
